metadata.title: MedOrbits Universities and Institutions Database
metadata.description: Directory of Indian and international universities and higher-education institutions, prioritising private, deemed, specialist, national and international institutions while retaining existing directory records.
metadata.idStrategy: Stable unique identifiers that remain unchanged when display names or URLs change.
metadata.sourcePolicy: Use official institutional websites, government directories and relevant regulatory authorities as authoritative sources.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify institutional identity, recognition and published claims before making records publicly discoverable.
metadata.unknownValuePolicy: Use null for unknown scalar values and empty arrays for known-empty or not-yet-populated collections.

sourceSnapshot.name: University Grants Commission university directory
sourceSnapshot.verificationNote: Original imported directory records retained. Newly added records are candidate entries with pending review; confirm institutional identity, official domain, recognition and current status before public promotion.

metadata.candidateRecordNote: Added entries are pending review, not individually verified. Original records retained. Some institutions may be represented in the original UGC import under alternate names; run name-level deduplication before public release.

id.description: Permanent institution identifier used by related datasets.

ugcInstitutionId.description: Institution identifier from the UGC directory when available.

summary.description: Source-based directory summary that does not imply independent verification.

stateName.description: State or union territory label supplied by the source directory.

recognitions.description: Recognition records supported by authoritative evidence.

accreditations.description: Accreditation records supported by authoritative evidence.

ugcStatus.description: Status label reported by the UGC directory; not an independent MedOrbits determination.

publicListingRequires: id, name and slug are valid
at least one relevant authoritative source is recorded
unverifiedPublicationRequires: at least one government-directory source is recorded
the public interface labels the record as not independently verified
recognition, accreditation, programme, fee and admission claims are not inferred
verifiedClaimsRequire: verification date and authorized reviewer are recorded
verified claims have current authoritative evidence
publicationRules.expiredOrWithdrawnRecognition: Display only with accurate status and context; never imply current validity.
publicationRules.missingRelationships: Use empty arrays where appropriate and do not create fabricated references.
publicationRules.brokenRelationships: Flag validation errors and prevent publication of affected records.
